entities.title: Work on Lundey
entities.summary: Install, test, build and look at the game in its folder.
steps: npm test (the type-check, then the maze, game and Worker tests)
npm run build (into dist/games/lundey/, with _headers at dist/)
npm run dev rebuilds the bundle as the source changes
To look at it without the sign-in: serve dist/ with any static server and open /games/lundey/

entities.title: Publish for the first time, and invite players
entities.summary: The owner's steps from a merged game to an invited player on the title screen.
entities.when: The owner has decided to publish (decisions.json, stands-in-for-request). Never on an agent's own initiative.
steps: In the icelander.net repository: merge the pull request that registers games:lundey (accounts/src/config.js) and adds the game's card, and deploy the login service and the site as that repository says
In games/lundey, on the owner's machine: npm run deploy
Grant games:lundey to each invited player at icelander.net/private/admin
Add the lundey pipeline file from .zazzle/zizd/README.md to the orchestrator, so later changes can go through zizd
entities.verify: At icelander.net/games/lundey/: signed out, the site's sign-in; signed in without the role, the not-invited page; signed in with it, the title screen.
